title: An Act to Provide for the Issuance of Enhanced Driver's Licenses and Enhanced Nondriver Identification Cards in Maine

summary.text: This bill authorizes the Secretary of State, upon request of the applicant, to issue an enhanced driver's license or enhanced nondriver identification card that meets the standards of the Western Hemisphere Travel Initiative developed by the United States Department of State and the United States Department of Homeland Security that allows United States citizens reentry from certain other countries. The bill also establishes fees for enhanced driver's licenses and enhanced nondriver identification cards.
